acceptance: The fence at database, route and scheduler; no platform run reads a tenant row; no tenant text in logs, model inputs or platform surfaces; SSRF on check_url; runner events validated; the cap's two points; attestation verification not trusting the library; the BE flag; the lockout guard; session limits; batch four eyes and apply; proof the diff touches none of tests_library_fence's allowlists or the boot guard beyond what packages declared; the authenticator list reviewed if merged; fixes test-first; lower findings as HARDENING rows.

title: The bank's agent proposes controls as linked internal items
goal: An owned control kind whose approval creates a REG-05 control item linked to the private obligation.
acceptance: Approval creates an InternalItem of the control kind linked to the private obligation through record() in the tenant zone, under the same private approval with four eyes and step-up; the agent's runner-event channel accepts it beside the obligation; the migration takes the next free proposals number; security review of the diff before finishing.
brief: Blocked: starts only when Alex has answered what a control inventory is. If his answer differs from the default (a REG-05 internal item of the control kind), follow the answer or stop and report. Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md. If still unanswered at R2 close, OWN-05 is named held and R2 closes without it.
